title: Counts and states come from GitHub REST; search only finds candidates
why: GitHub search lags and miscounts, so a report that quotes a search total gives the owner a wrong number. Incident 04:01 CST Nov 14 (triage's own): triage told the coordinator, a step note and an outbox line that "1 of 227 commits on main touched docs/records.md", from `git log -- docs/records.md` on a shallow local clone with default history simplification; the count was wrong (the redo, diffing each PR-merge commit against its first parent, gave 4 of 11 since Nov 13 and 20 of 38 since Nov 10, still approximate) and a lane designed around "1 per records change". A count of what merged to main belongs to REST (commits or PRs with a path filter, or each merged PR's files), not to a shallow clone's log. Guard that would have stopped it: the rule this step builds (counts from REST); until built, a count from a git log names its simplification (first-parent or full history) and the clone depth, and is marked approximate. No new step.
source: owner ruling 11:07 CST Nov 12 ("this is good" to option a, asked 11:05 CST), via the retrospective (session_013NEJKz5AWFJhGvmCUoi6wQ)
note: Ruled option a: a rule plus a guard. Counts and states (open, closed, merged, CI status) come from REST. Search only finds candidates by text, and each hit is confirmed with REST. Homes: a rule line in CLAUDE.md (Verification), and a guard or reply-judge item that flags a search total quoted as a count; it flags and never refuses (a reading mistake). Measure: search showed 0 PRs closed since 09:30 CST while REST showed 100 closed 10:00-11:00 CST Nov 12; the retrospective's search counts of open PRs (657, 752, 316) were wrong the same way. Note: the cloud system prompt sends sessions to `gh api search/...` for search; the rule must keep that for finding, not counting. Ready, no lane. Lane counts-from-rest started 11:10 CST Nov 12 (coordinator; Sonnet, medium). Folded in step progress-claims-cite-live-read (owner 11:07 CST Nov 12, "this is good"; retrospective 11:46 CST Nov 13).
